gloss: habit of fantasizing; tendency toward delusion

definitions.gloss: habit of fantasizing; tendency toward delusion or daydreaming
definitions.explanation: A persistent tendency to indulge in fantasies, unrealistic imaginings, or delusional thinking. Can range from harmless daydreaming to a more concerning pattern of detachment from reality.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{妄想癖|もうそうへき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: She has a habit of fantasizing.

examples.japanese: {妄想癖|もうそうへき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{想像|そうぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかなくなること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Because of a tendency toward delusion, one can sometimes lose the distinction between reality and imagination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{妄想癖|もうそうへき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦{恥|は}ずかしく→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I felt embarrassed when my friend told me I have a tendency to fantasize.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧ (delusion, fantasy) and {癖|へき} (habit, tendency). The {癖|へき} suffix indicates a habitual or compulsive behavior pattern, as seen in other compounds like ⟦{潔癖|けっぺき}→潔癖：26932_keppeki⟧ (fastidiousness) and {偏癖|へんぺき} (eccentricity).

The tone of {妄想癖|もうそうへき} depends on context. In casual conversation, it is often used light-heartedly to describe someone who tends to daydream or get carried away with romantic or dramatic imaginings. In more serious or clinical contexts, it can imply a concerning pattern of delusional thinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {妄想癖|もうそうへき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a fantasizing habit
- {妄想癖|もうそうへき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to have a strong tendency to fantasize
- {妄想癖|もうそうへき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to fix a fantasizing habit
- {妄想癖|もうそうへき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person prone to fantasizing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{妄想|もうそう}→妄想：06813_mousou⟧: delusion, fantasy — the act itself, without the connotation of habitual behavior
- {空想癖|くうそうへき}: daydreaming habit — similar but with a softer, more innocent connotation of imaginative thinking
- ⟦{被害妄想|ひがいもうそう}→被害妄想：18124_higaimousou⟧: persecution complex — a specific type of delusional thinking focused on believing one is being targeted
